## Important Instructions

**Do NOT submit a pull request to add faculty until the institution has been added.**

1. Fill out this issue to request the institution be added
2. Wait for a maintainer to add the institution to `institutions.csv`
3. Once confirmed, submit a **single PR** that adds **all** CS faculty at the institution

Partial departments are not allowed - you must add the entire CS department at once to ensure fair rankings.
